intro: This page lists the best government MBA / PGDM colleges in Rajasthan by the average packages in our records. We currently link {{count}} programme options at {{colleges}} colleges tagged as public in our file.

IIM Udaipur and MNIT Jaipur are the national institutes here, with Central University of Rajasthan and other public campuses. Banasthali Vidyapith is a private women's university and is no longer tagged as public in our file.
listLead: IIM Udaipur appears first, but the opening card may be a Management Development Programme rather than the two-year MBA. Read the programme name before you compare packages or fees.
snapshot: For colleges with a recorded average package, the median is {{pkgMedian}}, in a range from {{pkgMin}} to {{pkgMax}}. The recorded years run from {{pkgYearMin}} to {{pkgYearMax}}.
In the official NIRF 2025 Management ranking, IIM Udaipur is 21 and MNIT Jaipur is 62. Use those official ranks when you compare top MBA / PGDM colleges in Rajasthan 2026.
firstCollegesLead: IIM Udaipur has a 2024 recorded average of ₹19 LPA and a highest of ₹47 LPA on an MBA Finance row. One fee in our file is ₹20 lakh for a supply-chain MBA, so confirm the official notice.
MNIT Jaipur has a 2023 recorded average of ₹9 LPA. Central University of Rajasthan has a 2025 recorded average of ₹4 LPA. Confirm both figures in the official placement reports.

sections.heading: Admission exams and a tagging issue
paragraphs: CAT is the exam most often tagged here. Some older records still mention Rajasthan MAT, but current RTU material points to RMAP rather than a standalone RMAT 2026 exam.
Banasthali Vidyapith is a private deemed university and no longer appears on this government list. Confirm the institute type on the official site for any other campus you are unsure about.

compare.heading: How to compare the best government MBA / PGDM colleges in Rajasthan
paragraphs: Start with IIM Udaipur and MNIT Jaipur, then decide whether a specialised MBA in insurance, footwear or a private women's university belongs on your shortlist.
